text:
Anna: Heads-up — NimbusCloud's PO is stuck in our marketplace flow. The marketplace portal started returning an intermediate authorization step yesterday, so POs are waiting for Org Admin sign-off. It's blocking their purchase. @Mike can you check routing? :frowning:

Mike: saw this. The portal started returning a new status code `AWAITING_INTERMEDIATE_AUTH`. Our webhook handler treats unknown statuses as terminal, so the PO falls into a failed state. I'm going to map it to 'pending' temporarily.

Raj: can you pause the auto-reject job? it runs every 5m and is marking these as failed — otherwise we'll auto-cancel before any manual recovery.

Mike: pausing job now. ran: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/pause-job -d '{"job":"po-auto-reject"}'` — job paused.

Anna: customer is on the phone in 20m. we need an owner to escalate with marketplace PMs and a plan for immediate manual processing. @Sam any legal concerns about approving before all metadata is reconciled?

Sam: legal is OK with a documented manual acceptance for this one customer as long as Finance signs off and we attach the PO PDF and a short note explaining the exception. no need for contract redlines.

Lisa: salesops here — i'll get NimbusCloud to confirm an authorized signer and upload a scanned PO right now. Can we create a temporary entitlement so they can provision while we resolve the portal behavior?

Mike: yes — we can issue a manual entitlement and link it to the PO. I'll create it via internal API: `POST /entitlements {"customer":"NimbusCloud","sku":"redwood-dedicated","note":"manual ent while portal blocked"}`. Doing it now.

ops-bot: Deployment job po-ingest-fanout: paused by Mike at 2024-06-07T15:12Z

Raj: once manual entitlement is created i'll process a one-off invoice and route it to Sam for the written approval. please CC me on the uploaded PO file.

Anna: timeline estimate: 30-45m to get customer upload + manual entitlement + finance sign-off. i'll update NimbusCloud and escalate to marketplace PMs for a permanent fix. :thumbsup:

Sam: i'll draft a short approval note template that can be attached to the record (signed-by, signer-email, timestamp, reason).

Mike: follow-up: i'm also adding a mapping rule to treat `AWAITING_INTERMEDIATE_AUTH` as `PENDING` across our integration layer and webhook parser. will run tests in staging and if green roll to prod. ETA for automation: ~3h. temporary manual flow is live.

Anna: copy. keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the customer. if this pattern repeats we should add the status to our marketplace compatibility matrix and notify Sales Enablement. i'll log a short incident note after wrap.

Mike: will post the patch PR link and a short changelog here once tests finish.

Anna: thanks everyone — pinging again if anything blocks the handoff to Finance or Legal.
